## Overview

Deity of death and the grave. Presides over life's end. Shadow elves (shadar-kai) are her primary worshippers. As a fragment of A or C, her power depletes over time when used and is replenished by mortal worship — the grief, fear, and reverence surrounding death are her fuel.

## Domains
- Death: The end of life, authority over mortal expiration
- Grave: The cycle of life and death, opposing undeath

## Personality
Solemn, patient, absolute. She oversees death as a natural cycle. Despises undeath.

## Worship
Clergy tend the dying, guard graveyards, destroy undead. Shadar-kai serve as her agents.
